title: Week 14 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “stock”?
options: Money accumulated gradually for a known future expense.
The price paid for insurance coverage.
An ownership interest in a corporation.
Efforts to obtain payment of a debt, subject to applicable law.
questions.explanation: Stock means an ownership interest in a corporation.
choices: Money accumulated gradually for a known future expense.
The price paid for insurance coverage.
An ownership interest in a corporation.
Efforts to obtain payment of a debt, subject to applicable law.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “bond”?

A debt instrument promising specified payments subject to issuer risk.
The maximum amount an insurer will pay under a provision.
The amount a current sum is expected to grow to under stated assumptions.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “mutual fund”?
options: Failure to meet contractual repayment terms, often after specified delinquency.
A transaction exceeding the available account balance, potentially causing fees or declined payment.
A pooled investment vehicle issuing shares and holding a portfolio under a stated strategy.
A fraud targeting prior victims with promises to recover lost money for a fee.

questions.question: Which definition best matches “exchange-traded fund”?
options: A tax on wages used for programs such as Social Security and Medicare.
Revolving debt balance relative to available revolving credit.
The timing and amount of money entering and leaving an account.
A pooled investment fund whose shares trade on an exchange.
questions.explanation: Exchange-traded fund means a pooled investment fund whose shares trade on an exchange.
choices: A tax on wages used for programs such as Social Security and Medicare.

The amount the insured pays before specified coverage begins.
